text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The study duration is 6 years which includes 5 years' academic study and 1 year's internship. Admitted by Ministry of Education of China. There are more than 55 compulsory courses and 7 optional courses. Excellent and high-qualified teaching faculty. The School is listed on WHO's official website and admitted by ECFMG, U.S. 2. Internship Editor Notes: This program will offer lots of internship opportunities for students. Students will do the internship in the final academic year. Students can only choose to do the internship in China, not other countries. Students need to pay full tuition fee in the final academic year. 4. School Introduction Editor Notes: It is one of the 30 or so medical universities in China which are approved by Ministry of Education in China. Chongqing Medical University (CQMU) ,founded in 1956, is a key university under the administration of Chongqing Municipal Government with an integrated educational system of Bachelor's, Master's, Doctor's and Postdoctoral programs in medicine as well as other related fields , Learn More>> 5. International Cooperation Editor Notes: The university has been actively conducting international exchanges and cooperation. ​ The School has cooperated with above 20 countries and regions in the world for staff training, exchange of students, academic exchanges and scientific research. There are 98 foreign medical experts who have become visiting or honorary professors. The School has 4 state key disciplines and 29 municipal key disciplines. The School owns 4 affiliated hospitals which are all rated as 'Upper First-class Hospitals' in China. 6. Campus Life Editor Notes: International students enjoy the wonderful life in the campus.
